name: loyalty-pos-system
description: Loyalty POS System — Backend + Admin Dashboard + POS Terminal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,admin,pos -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:pos"
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env PORT=3002 npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently -k "npm --prefix admin-dashboard run dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n backend,admin,pos -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm --prefix admin-dashboard run dev" "npm run dev:pos:electron"
scripts.dev:pos:electron: concurrently -n vite,electron -c magenta,yellow "npm --prefix restaurant-pos/Frontend run dev" "wait-on --timeout 60000 http://localhost:5175 && npm --prefix restaurant-pos run electron:dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix admin-dashboard run build && npm --prefix restaurant-pos/Frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix admin-dashboard install && npm --prefix restaurant-pos/Frontend install
